notes.title: 20241223 Updata
notes.notes:
[h3]Character Adjustments[/h3]
[b]Cowboy[/b]
[list]
[*] No longer increases attack speed and cooldown reduction.
[*] Damage reduction effect weakened.
[*] Initial skill slots increased by 2, but weapon collection bonuses are disabled.
[*] Bonus true damage effect remains unchanged.
[/list]
[b]Hermit:[/b]
[list]
[*] No longer reduces attack speed and cooldown.
[*] Initial skill slots reduced by 3, but gains 3x weapon collection bonuses.
[*] Enhanced single-strike effect remains unchanged.
[/list]

[h3]Experience Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Gambler will no longer draw Demon’s Blood before level 30.
[*] The Gambler will no longer draw Little Piggy Bank.
[*] Removed the achievement [Defeat 1,000 Bosses]
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Fury would not work after being unequipped and reactivated.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [Damage Overload] achievement could not be obtained without drawing the battle pass.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapon enhancements: Flying Saw, Missile, Mechanical Warhammer, and Infrared Lock-on.
[/list]

notes.title: 20241217 Updata
notes.notes:
[b]Extra Difficulty Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue caused by rounding down during experience deduction calculations.
[*] Adjusted monster damage and health across all levels, reducing them slightly while keeping scores unchanged.
[/list]

[b]Endless Mode Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the overall growth rate of enemy stats.
[*] After Wave 5, significantly increased the health of regular enemies.
[*] After Wave 10, accelerated the health and armor growth of both regular and elite enemies.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in Impossible difficulty where players had to click "Go" twice, even when level requirements were met.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.2.2 Updata
notes.notes:
[h3]Fixes and Optimizations:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slight decrease in Hell and Impossible difficulty levels.
[*] Moderate reduction in difficulty for each option and level of the extra difficulty (scores remain unchanged).
[*] The base upgrade skill points for the Gambler have been increased from 20 to 30. The upgrade skill points for levels 5 and 7 have been increased from 8 to 10.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.2.1 Updata
notes.notes:
1. Adjusted Difficulty:
Slightly reduced difficulty levels for all options in Extra Difficulty mode (scores remain unchanged).
2. Endless Mode Balance:
Slightly reduced the damage scaling rate.
3. Boss Timer in Endless Mode:
A countdown timer for boss appearances will now be displayed.
4. New Setting:
Added the option to disable damage pop-ups.
5. Balance Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Holy Shield: Reduced base cooldown.
[*] Mythril Pendant: Increased bonus damage cap from [50 + Character Level × 2] to [50 + Character Level × 4].
[*] Starting Weapon Enhancements: Improved Double Pistols, Shotgun, and Lightning Wand
[/list]
6. Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the Gambler would immediately learn a skill when starting with 100 initial skill points as a Beginner.
[*] Resolved an issue where the interface would scroll abnormally when not using controller input.
[/list]

notes.title: Brand new characters and endless mode are now updated!
notes.notes:
The roguelike bullet heaven game “Pape Rangers” now updated with new characters and endless mode!
And the game is now participating in Bullet Heaven Festival 2.0, 20% off sale, after the discount price of only $3.19.

Welcome to purchase/update to experience the latest version of the game content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44873681/309de9d789a49c4e579c82c2bee29270ee86ec86.jpg[/img]

[h3]Update Contents[/h3]
[b]1.New Characters[/b]
[list]
[*] The Chosen One: Can ignore prerequisite conditions on the skill tree and learn any skills at will.
[*] The Gambler: Cannot choose skills manually; leaves everything to fate.
[/list]

[b]2.New In-Game Combination Classes & Relics[/b]
[list]
[*] Shadow Dancer: A powerful assassin utilizing shadows.
[*] Hunter: A versatile class inspired by a certain world’s hunters, proficient in melee, ranged, and summoning.
[*] Cyber Maniac: A frenzied warrior driven mad by mechanical augmentations.
[*] Death Knight: Where there’s a Paladin, there’s also a Dark Knight.
[*] Mecha Dragon Craftsman: Creator of advanced mechanical lifeforms.
[*] 6 New Relics: Magic Backpack, Space Ring, Angel’s Blood, Demon’s Blood, Battle Pass, Mechanical Life Core.
[/list]

[b]3.Core Game Mechanic Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] There is now a limit to the number of weapons that can be simultaneously activated. Players must strategically decide which weapons to activate during battles for optimal performance.
[*] As compensation, learned but inactive weapons now provide attribute bonuses.
[*] c.Certain cards can increase the maximum number of simultaneously active weapons.
[/list]

[b]4New Feature: "Extra Challenges"[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can customize additional modifiers at Impossible difficulty to increase the challenge level.
[*] "Extra Challenges" do not grant additional experience but significantly boost the score multiplier.
[*] Each character/weapon’s highest score can now be viewed on the "Achievements" page.
[/list]

[b]5.New Feature: "Endless Challenge"[/b]
[list]
[*] After winning a game at Hard difficulty or higher, players can choose to enter Endless Mode.
[/list]

[b]6.12 New Achievements[/b]

[b]7.High-Difficulty Stage Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Drastically reduced monster damage.
[*] Slightly increased monster numbers.
[*] Significantly increased monster health.
[*] Overall, the adjustments increase the room for error in high-difficulty modes, emphasizing player strategy and output capabilities.
[/list]

[b]8.Balance Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Made balance adjustments to most characters, weapons, and skills.
[*] Some scaling skills are now limited in Endless Mode to maintain balance.
[/list]

[b]9.Character Completion Indicator[/b]
[list]
[*] Added colored badges to indicate characters that have completed specific challenges.
[/list]

[b]10.Controller Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] When viewing the skill tree, players can now use the directional keys (up, down, left, right) for navigation.
[/list]

[b]11.Bug Fixes[/b]
[*] Fixed some UI and text display issues.
[*] Resolved incorrect icon display issues.
[*] Fixed attribute display errors for weapons with levels above 3.
[*] Corrected an issue where opening a chest and transitioning to the upgrade screen would prevent the keyboard from closing the upgrade interface properly.
[/list]

Welcom to join in our Discord: https://discord.gg/yuuKfnseaa
Looking forward to your feedback!

notes.title: V 1.1.2 Update 20241009
notes.notes:
[h3]Optimization and bug fixes：[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Collection" feature.
[*] Shields and dragons are no longer affected by effect transparency adjustments.
[*] Curses now have an additional effect: reduces monster hit rate by 30%.
[*] Fixed issues with certain controller interactions.
[*] Adjusted interactions on the main interface.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.1 Update 20240927
notes.notes:
[h3]Optimization and Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Controller handling has been adjusted, and an attempt has been made to fix potential bugs.
[*] Hermit Talent Update:
1. Before: Each time a new weapon is acquired, empowered attack cooldown is reduced by 0.2 seconds (minimum 1 second), and damage is increased by 20%, with no cap.
2. Now: For each level up in-game, empowered  attack cooldown is reduced by 0.04 seconds (minimum 1 second), and damage is increased by 6%, with no cap.
[*] The armor boost when monsters are frozen has been reduced from 100 to 30.
[*] Impromptu Strike: The temporary dodge rate increase can now surpass the 66% dodge cap.
[/list]

notes.title: HotFix 20240924
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where the garbage bin pickup would have abnormal behavior after closing the draw card interface

notes.title: V1.1.0 Update, new controller compatibility feature!
notes.notes:
[h3]Optimizations and fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added support for gamepad input
[*] Fixed an issue where picking up multiple trash cans at the same time could cause some trash cans to be lost
[*] Little Piggy Savings: The interest rate has been increased to 6%, and the maximum interest cap has been lowered to 500
[*] Slightly weakened the ice arrow, while enhancing three weapons: Ice Storm, Flying Saw, and Missile.
[*] Modified the conflict rules between Ignite and Freeze: Enemies that are frozen cannot be ignited, and enemies that are ignited cannot be frozen. Previously, Ignite and Freeze would cancel each other out.
[*] Experience points for the Below Hell difficulty have been adjusted to the same as the Impossible difficulty
[*] Fixed some UI display errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Update V1.0.5 on 20240819
notes.notes:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[b]New Artifacts[/b]
[list]
[*] VIP666 - Current game experience bonus +30%, after-game experience gain +50%.
[*] Map of Hidden Treasures - 50% chance for monsters to drop double the number of trash cans.
[*] Little Piggy Savings - Gain 4% interest every 30 seconds based on current skill points, with a maximum of 24 points at 600 skill points. No interest is gained beyond this limit.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments and Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] For Novice: the upgrade skill points gained at levels 3 and 8 have been increased from +5 to +8. The card draw cost reduction at level 9 has been increased from 5% to 8%.
[*] Cowboys now gain an additional 0.5 real damage per level.
[*] Out-of-game mage upgrade effects have been changed: Level 3 now grants card Magic Mastery at the start instead of increasing magic recovery, and Level 7 now grants card Element Mastery at the start instead of increasing maximum magic value.
[*] In-game magic skills have been adjusted: Meditation now also restores magic based on a percentage, key magic passives now increase maximum magic value, overall damage and magic consumption have been increased.
[*] Magic potion recovery has been changed from 150 to 100 + 10% of maximum magic value.
[*] During Magic Frenzy (Fire Mage), attack speed, cooldown reduction, and movement speed are now increased by 30%, with duration and cooldown changed to 8 seconds.
[*] Unyielding Will (Guardian) life recovery has been increased from 0.2 to 0.5.
[*] Blood of Revenge (Berserker) price has been reduced from 200 to 100.
[*] The Experience Gain Rune and Exp Collect Range Rune have been combined into one card, which now has the effects of both cards, with no change in price.
[*] Adjusted the collision detection of most monsters and their projectiles to better match their display.
[*] Increased the weight of level 2 and level 3 weapons appearing on certain key paths, making it slightly easier to advance toward the target profession.
[*] Updated the achievements for killing monsters/killing Bosses to have more reasonable challenge numbers.
[*] Added level detection and gameplay tips on high difficulty level selection.
[*] Added a tutorial on the visibility of special effects and character statuses.
[*] Standardized the damage of most minor enemies.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The English version has undergone text proofreading; there should be way less spelling errors.
[*] Fixed the bug where garbage bins would endlessly open when in collision with Dragon Egg, fixed the bug where Dragon Egg still increased attributes when not near the main character, and refined the description of the Dragon Egg.
[*] Corrected the penetration values displayed for some weapons.
[*] Fixed some UI display errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Update on August 16
notes.notes:
[h3]Optimizations and Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The EXP required for out-of-game leveling has been adjusted, reducing the EXP needed to level up characters and weapons to a certain level.
[*] The in-game EXP-leveling up curve has been slightly adjusted.
[*] The mana cost of the Crystal Blade has been reduced from 3 to 1, also with a slight increase in damage.
[*] The damage of fire and ice magic has been adjusted, with an overall increase in damage.
[*] The base attack speed of Shadow Ray has been increased from 180/min to 240/min.
[*] Fixed some UI display errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Update on August 15
notes.notes:
[h3]Optimization and fixes：[/h3]
[list]
[*] Healing potion amount increased from 10 to 20, and mana potion recovery increased from 100 to 150.
[*] Blade·Split damage reduction is decreased from 80 to 60, melee damage bonus reduction is decreased from 0.8 to 0.7; Blade·Concentration damage increase is raised from 30 to 60.
[*] Slightly reduced the health of the boss Golem.
[*] The magic percentage recovery of the Evil Holy Grail increased from 1% to 2.5%.
[*] For Drained Crystal Sphere: the MP increase per 100 MP consumed is increased from 4 to 5.
[*] Adjusted the power of most mage skills, resulting in an overall increase in mage damage.
[*] Extended the invincibility time after dashing by 0.1 seconds, and reduced the cooldown for dashing in higher difficulty settings.
[*] Fixed some UI display errors and a few rare bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update on August 13, 2024
notes.notes:
[h3]Optimization and fixes：[/h3]
[list]
[*] The refresh price has been reduced, starting at 10, with an increase of 5 for each refresh, capping at 50.
[*] The lock price is fixed at 20.
[*] The rules for locking HP during the boss phase has been changed—now the boss lock its HP when its HP drops too quickly. Adjustments of HP locking have also been made during the boss's skill phase. In general, the instances of HP locking are significantly reduced . As a balance, the health of some bosses has been slightly increased.
[*] The global damage bonus now has a lower limit, and is now set to -65%.
[*] The Cowboy's true damage bonus has been increased from 5 to 10, and the true damage bonus at level 9 has also been increased from 5 to 10.
[*] The Amulet of Oppression no longer reduces movement speed and now increases maximum health by 20.
[*] The Giant's Heart percentage-based health regeneration has been changed from 3% every 5 seconds to 1% per second, and the UI is now displayed correctly.
[*] The Dragon Egg now has a damage cap per hit, maintaining some resistance against ferocious monsters at higher difficulties.
[*] Slightly reduced the damage of monsters in below Hell difficulty (Impossible is still impossible).
[*] Fixed some UI display errors.
[/list]
